findings: The application is only the nonsingular characteristic-zero short model, so the corrected general omega factor specializes to4y, and even psi is2y times f. It does not adopt the faulty general-model printed parity literally.

Substituting parity into the odd recurrence gives D0L-R for even m and L-D0R for odd m. In the even recurrence both parities cancel in the polynomial ring and give the stated f2m recurrence. The displayed bases agree after a4=A and other ai=0.

The corrected numerator and even recurrence yield psi2n=2psi_n omega_n for n>=3. At n1 the identity formula gives omega1=y; at n2 duplication gives the same identity. No specialized zero ordinate is cancelled.

Part(f) identifies zeros as nonidentity n-torsion, so the separately established torsion-free carrier gives psi_n(P)!=0 on the nonidentity n!=0 branch. Coordinate clearing is then reversible. Negative indices use psi_-n=-psi_n and short-model negation; scalar0 and identity are separate branches.
